title: Agentic AI Defense: Decode-Time Provenance Binding for MCP
abstract: arXiv:2610.31974v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic AI systems using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection through untrusted tool outputs. We demonstrate cross-modal trust laundering, in which instructions concealed in an email-signature image using least-significant-bit (LSB), discrete cosine transform (DCT), or metadata steganography bypass text scanners and enter a multi-agent workflow when decoded by a tool. To counter this threat, we propose decode-time provenance binding, which combines HMAC-authenticated trust labels with an MCP-maintained provenance ledger and context-taint tracking. The mechanism labels decoded content as untrusted and blocks critical tool calls influenced by that content, even when a compromised agent substitutes a valid trusted label. translated_title: 智能体AI防御：面向MCP的解码时溯源绑定
translated_abstract: 使用模型上下文协议的智能体AI系统容易通过不可信的工具输出遭受间接提示注入攻击。我们演示了跨模态信任洗白攻击，即利用最低有效位（LSB）、离散余弦变换（DCT）或元数据隐写术将指令隐藏在电子邮件签名图像中，绕过文本扫描器，并在工具解码该图像时进入多智能体工作流。为应对这一威胁，我们提出解码时溯源绑定机制，将基于HMAC认证的信任标签与MCP维护的溯源账本以及上下文污点跟踪相结合。该机制将解码内容标记为不可信，并阻止受该内容影响的关键工具调用，即使被入侵的智能体替换了有效的可信标签也能实现防护。我们在真实的MCP测试平台上，使用三种隐写载体和24个自适应载荷对该方法进行了评估。未加防御的流水线攻击成功率为100%，而基于关键词的方法……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出解码时溯源绑定机制，通过HMAC认证的信任标签、MCP维护的溯源账本和上下文污点跟踪三者的结合，有效防御针对MCP智能体系统的跨模态隐写式间接提示注入攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes decode-time provenance binding—combining HMAC-authenticated trust labels, an MCP-maintained provenance ledger, and context-taint tracking—to defend agentic AI systems against cross-modal steganographic indirect prompt injection attacks.
